name: Baosheng Science and Technology Innovation Co.,Ltd.
summary: Baosheng Science and Technology Innovation Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, sales, and service of wires, cables, and cable accessories in China, Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan. The company offers power cables, electrical equipment cables, communication cables, and optical fibers. It also provides aerospace; marine and marine engineering; submarine; power transmission and distribution line; rail vehicle; automotive; petrochemical and metallurgical applications; building; and mobile cables, as well as new energy wires and cables; cable system; and other products.
